Help & FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

  • How do I create a profile?
    Sign up and fill in your details on the Create Profile page.
  • How do I verify my profile?
    Upload a selfie or video in the Settings page under Profile Verification.
  • How do I join live events?
    Check the Live Events section in Settings for upcoming events and RSVP.
  • How do I report a user?
    Use the Safety Toolkit in Settings to report users or call emergency contacts.
  • How do I upgrade to Diamond?
    Go to the Payment page and select your preferred premium tier.

Contact Support

Email: support@meengle.app

For urgent issues, use the Safety Toolkit in the app.

Troubleshooting

  • App not loading? Try refreshing or clearing your browser cache.
  • Can't log in? Make sure your credentials are correct and your account is verified.
  • Payment issues? Contact support or check your payment method.
